content:
🧪  `frames-devnet@v0.2.0`: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-frames-devnet@v0.2.0

We are using this EELS branch for reference: [`devnets/frames/0`](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/tree/devnets/frames/0)

PTAL at the release notes & the test [release tracker](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/issues/3521) for the full scope.
Spec update plus new coverage, re-frozen at [`EIPs@b75cbe6`](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/b75cbe61150f09a44c38843be916417283d5b7bf/EIPS/eip-8141.md), rebased onto the current `forks/amsterdam`.

**New in v0.2.0:**
- Frame-transaction variants of the convertible legacy state tests: ~5.2k extra cases at `Bogota`, look for the `_frame_tx` fixture-format suffix.
- EIP-8141: block execution gas accounted before refunds per EIP-7778, payer and receipt stay post-refund [EIPs#12226](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12226).
- EIP-8141: redundant frame state-gas-limit check removed [EIPs#12276](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12276).
- EIP-8141: spent gas pinned across refill rollbacks (batch unroll & frame revert).
